label: organization located or based in
definition: Organization 1 is based in or has headquarters, offices or a campus in geographic place 2.
scope_notes: Historical bases and explicit organizational sites qualify. People, award recipients, leadership offices and merely named-as paths are other predicates.

MCI is explicitly based and headquartered in Washington.
Motorola is explicitly based in Schaumburg; both direct and semiconductor-company paths agree.
